name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.202
notes: Fixed the Total Today card showing contradictory messages when pace tracking is active, for example an orange Below Minimum warning stacked directly above a green Ahead of Pace card.

The static Below Minimum banner (a full-day-total check written before pace tracking existed) is now suppressed once the pacing engine has a first fluid entry to work from, since the pace card already gives the correct time-aware answer.
Above Maximum and Within Target Range messaging is unchanged.
label: PaceUiConsistency
summary: Removes a contradictory pair of messages on the fluid dashboard: a full-day Below Minimum warning could appear next to an Ahead of Pace card saying the opposite.
fixes: isBelowMin banner (range mode) now only shows when the pacing engine is not active (no first fluid entry logged yet, or pacing not configured), avoiding a direct visual contradiction with the pace card.
changes: range-mode Total Today block: isBelowMin branch split into pacing-active (suppressed) and pacing-inactive (shown as before) cases.
No unrelated CardiacLens behavior was intentionally changed.
testing: Verified bracket balance delta matches the new code added only.
